_comment: USD per 1M tokens. Edit freely - tokentrack reads this at runtime. Optional per-model status (verified | estimated | unverified; absent = verified), source_url, verified_on and note are provenance; _verified_rates lists the rates the provider confirmed.
_anthropic_source: Anthropic list pricing. cache_write_5m = 1.25x input, cache_write_1h = 2x input, cache_read = 0.1x input.
_google_source: Public Gemini API pricing, Sept 2026. All Flash tiers (3.6/3.7/3.8) share $0.75 in / $3.75 out introductory rates through 2026-12-31, then double. Cache rates approximate.
_openai_source: gpt-6.1-sol / gpt-6-luna: rates supplied by the user 2026-10-14. Cache write rates configured/estimated.

gemini-3.6-flash.note: Model page https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.6-flash. in/out/cr match the Standard paid list through 2026-12-31; from 2027-01-01 the provider lists 1.50 / 7.50 / 0.15, which this file does not model (no dated price schedule). Gemini publishes no per-token cache-write rate; cw5m and cw1h are the values carried in this file. All rates confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-15.

gemini-3.5-flash.note: Deprecated alias; model page says auto-routed to gemini-3.6-flash. Pricing page https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing has no separate gemini-3.5-flash price entry. in/out/cr are set to the gemini-3.6-flash Standard rates, and cw5m/cw1h match that entry; Gemini publishes no per-token cache-write rate. All rates confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-15.

gpt-6.1-sol.note: Model page https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol. Provider-stated: in 2, out 10, cached input 0.10 (5% of input), matching the Standard short-context rates. Cache writes (cw5m/cw1h) 2.50 (1.25x input) match the provider list; previously 2.0, changed on 2026-10-15. Long-context (>272K input) not modeled. All rates confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-15.

currency._comment: All costs are computed in USD then multiplied by per_usd. Set per_usd to 1 and code to USD for dollars.

_openrouter_source: GLM/Kimi in/out: OpenRouter list prices (Sept 2026). Cache read: rate implied by OpenRouter-billed cost in omp logs. Cache write not billed; set to input.
